r-blocks-help: Lighé n ativator a na azion. Strasciné i bloches dala cassa di strumënc. Adurvé l editur dl formular per la opzions avanzades.
r-blocks-discard: Lascé perde la modifiche di bloches nia salvedes?
r-blocks-unavailable: I dac dla regola ne ie nia a desposizion. Adurvé l editur dl formular per controlé chësta regola.
r-blocks-invalid: Lighé giust n ativator a na azion. Scancelé i bloches deslighé o en plu dan da salvé.
r-blocks-conflict: Chësta regola ie stata mudeda ntant che la mudueves. Ciarié danü la regola salveda dan da salvé.
r-blocks-permission: L va de bujën dl permëss de aministrator dla tabela per modifiché regoles.
scrum-policy-doneLists: Ciarta te na lista dla categoria Fenì
scrum-rollover-sprint: Sposté l laour nia fenì a
scrum-edit-sprint: Creé o mudé n sprint planifié
scrum-releases-select-help: Na ciarta po ester te de plü publicazions. Tëgn Ctrl (Cmd sön n Mac) por tlü fora plü de öna; tó demez dötes por tó demez la ciarta da vigni publicazion.
scrum-select-sprint: Chirì fora n sprint per udëi sia relazion.
scrum-backlog-help: Ordené l laour aldò dla posizion tla lista di laours da fé. Assegné les ciartes a n sprint planifié o atif.
scrum-backlog-rank: Posizion tla lista di laours da fé
scrum-no-closed-sprints: Deguna istantanea de n sprint stlut é a desposizion.
scrum-report-help: Les relazions mantegn les stimes dles istantanees di sprints. Les stimes nia cunescides vën cuntedes da sëules; les ne é nia stimes de zero. Confronté la velocità demé cun les medemes unités de stima y regoles.
scrum-confirm-close: Stluje chësc sprint y salvé si resultac? Les ciartes nia fenides vën spostedes tla destinazion chirida fora.
scrum-confirm-cancel: Anulé chësc sprint? Sies ciartes resta te chësc sprint fin che les vën assegnedes danüef.
scrum-list-category: Categoria dl flus de laour Scrum
scrum-partial-report: Relazion parziala: la conten demé les ciartes al mumënt assegnedes a vos.
scrum-import-reference-omitted: N referimënt dla fontana ne é nia unì restauré: __reference__
scrum-partial-snapshot: Chësc sprint conten demé na pert dla istantanea originala.
scrum-resume-close: Continué la stlujura interota dl sprint
scrum-rollover-progress: Spostament inant dles ciartes dl sprint: __done__ de __total__
scrum-history-job-running: Anulament o repetizion de na mudazion gran: __done__ de __total__ linies dla cronologia
scrum-history-job-failed: L’anulament o la repetizion de na mudazion gran s’à fermé. Sfracé danü anulé o fé danü per jì inant:
scrum-daily-observations: Laour preudù y laour che manca per uni di (osservazions)
scrum-daily-observations-help: Uni bara mostra la prima osservazion registreda de n di UTC, al mumënt indiqué. I dis che manca vën lascés ora. Chëstes osservazions ne registrea nia uni mudaziun y ne mostra nia i totai ala fin dl di. Les stimes nia cunescides ne é nia zero. Dauré l azion Esporté de chësta sezion per les osservazions de uni di; l azion Esporté tla bara di strumënc esportëia i resultac dl sprint.
scrum-daily-truncated: Al vën mostré demé les ultimes 366 osservazions.
scrum-daily-empty: Deguna osservazion de uni di é unida registreda per chësc sprint.
scrum-scope-history: Estensiun dl laur y laur che resta, mudaziun per mudaziun
scrum-scope-history-help: Reconstruì dala Cronologia dl tofl dal scomenciamënt dl sprint: na riga per vigni mudaziun dles ciartes, dles stimes o dl laur finì dl sprint.
scrum-scope-history-inconsistent: La Cronologia ne reconstruësc nia le stat salvé de chësc sprint: valgünes mudaziuns é gnüdes fates zënza Cronologia, por chël ne é chisc valurs nia complets.
scrum-scope-history-truncated: Al é sté poscibl de lì ma les prömes mudaziuns; la reconstruziun ne é nia completa.
scrum-scope-history-empty: Degüna mudaziun dal scomenciamënt dl sprint.
scrum-daily-observations-export-help: Prima osservazion registreda de uni di UTC; i dis che manca vën lascés ora. Les osservazions ne registrea nia uni mudaziun o i totai ala fin dl di. Les stimes nia cunescides ne é nia zero.
scrum-import-pending: L importazion Scrum ne é nia fenida. Les mudaziuns Scrum y l esportazion dles relazions ne é nia a desposizion.
scrum-import-recovery-hint: N'importaziun interota da n inandiament da nü pó gní finida chiló do ch'ara s'é fermada. Sce so plan ne é nia gnü salvé deldut, é pa ma poscibl de l'anulé; chësc ne müda nia sul tofl.
scrum-import-into-board: Importé la planificaziun Scrum te chësc tofl
scrum-import-into-board-hint: Tlü fora n'esportaziun de n tofl de WeKan o n documënt de trasferimënt Scrum. I sprint y les publicazions che chësc tofl à bele vëgn lis, mai dopiá. Les ciartes vëgn assegnades dal ID, o dal numer y titul dla ciarta; les ciartes che ne va nia adöm vëgn metüdes sö y resta coche ares é. Ciara dan dut la vijion dant por odëi ci che se müda.
scrum-import-choose-file: Tlü fora dan dut n documënt.
scrum-import-invalid-file: Chësc documënt n'é nia n JSON valit.
scrum-import-preview-sprints: Sprint: __created__ nüs, __matched__ bele sön chësc tofl, __skipped__ nia importá
scrum-import-preview-releases: Publicazions: __created__ nöies, __matched__ bele sön chësc tofl, __skipped__ nia importades
scrum-import-preview-cards: Ciartes: __updated__ da ajorné, __unchanged__ nia mudades, __unmatched__ nia assegnades
scrum-import-preview-nothing: Nia da mudé: chësc tofl à bele chësta planificaziun.
scrum-import-into-board-done: La planificaziun Scrum é gnüda importada y registrada tla Cronologia.
scrum-import-card-not-matched: Na ciarta ne n'é nia gnüda abinada sön chësc tofl: __reference__
scrum-import-card-ambiguous: Na ciarta va adöm cun plü de öna na ciarta sön chësc tofl: __reference__
scrum-import-card-on-another-board: Na ciarta é de n'ater tofl y é restada coche ara ê: __reference__
scrum-import-record-ambiguous: N sprint o na publicazion va adöm cun plü de un sön chësc tofl: __reference__
scrum-import-record-not-imported: N sprint, na publicazion o n avenimënt ne n'é nia gnü da importé: __reference__
scrum-import-sprint-finished: Na ciarta ne n'é nia gnüda spostada te n sprint conclüdü: __reference__
sync-conflict-hint: Chirì fora n valor per uni conflit. La sincronisazion prova danüef do uni lita. Al ne vën nia mané al sistem de urigin.
sync-conflict-refresh: Fejé jì la sincronisazion danüef per controlé i valorei atuai.
sync-conflict-review-complete: Les ciartes assegnedes a vos é unides controledes. Al ne resta degun conflit de ciamp. La sincronisazion de duta la lista ne é nia unida fata.
sync-conflict-detach: Mantenì l dopl coche ciarta locala
sync-conflict-detach-hint: Tolé via demé l colegamënt de sincronisazion de chësc dopl. Si contegn resta te WeKan.
sync-conflict-archive-hint: L elemënt de urigin ne é nia plu, ma les sotciartes atives impedësc l archiviazion. Mantenì chësta ciarta localmënter cun tolé via si colegamënt de sincronisazion. Les sotciartes ne vën nia mudedes.
sync-conflict-creation: Creé na ciarta de sostituzion per la sincronisazion
sync-conflict-creation-hint: Mantenì la ciarta de dan zënza mudéla y creé na nueva ciarta de sincronisazion te chësta lista. I nuefs tentatifs daura la medema sostituzion.
sync-preview-saved: Basé sules impostazions salvedes. Sincronisé sëura ciaria y controlea danüef la fontana.
sync-preview-unavailable: Salvé na fontana de sincronisazion dan de damandé na anteprima.
sync-preview-blocked: Solvé i conflits ca sot dan de controlé l plan dles mudaziuns.
sync-preview-truncated: Al vën mostré les primes 100 vosc.
sync-preview-scope: I numers se referësc ai ciamps normalisés dla fontana. L analisadëur dla fontana pò lascé ora d'autri dac.
sync-preview-excluded: Lascé ora dala lita di ciamps salveda
sync-source-heading: Ciamps dla fontana nia copies diretamënter
sync-source-scope: I percors met adum les ocorënzes di ciamps danter i elemënc dla fontana. I ogec zënza colegamënt vën segnalés coche n intier; si valorei ne vën nia mostrés.
sync-source-excluded: Lascé ora dala lita di ciamps salveda
sync-source-converted: Convertì te test o n'autra forma
sync-source-fallback: Valor alternatif nia dauré dal analisadëur
sync-source-occurrences: Ocorënzes mustredes de ciamps o elemënc
sync-source-truncated: La relazion é limiteda a 100 percors y inuemes di ciamps scurtés.
sync-source-omitted: Autres ocorënzes fora di percors mostrés
sync-report-retention: Ultimes 20 esecuzions. Les relazions vën conservedes per 30 dis.
sync-report-partial: Les esecuzions falides o nia fenides pò avëi mudé valguna ciarta. Chëstes relazions ne continua nia y ne anulea nia na esecuzion.
sync-report-unfinished: Tl laour o interot; resultat nia registré
sync-report-completed-with-warnings: Fenì cun ciamps lascés ora o convertis
sync-report-unavailable: Les relazions dles esecuzions damanda l aces de scritura a duta la lista y n server a desposizion.
sync-recovery-description: Relazions de sincronisazion conservedes di ultimi 30 dis. Chirì aldò dl ID dla tabela o dla lista. Na esecuzion nia fenida pò ester mo tl laour o interota. Agiorné per controlé danüef; chëstes relazions ne pò nia continué o anulé les mudaziuns.
sync-recovery-unavailable: Al ne é nia stat meso lieje la diagnostica de sincronisazion. Controlé l aces de aministradëur y la disponibilità dl server.
sync-estimate-field-hint: Chirì fora n ciamp numerich cun n ID de ciamp Jira y na unità de stima, coche creé da na importazion Jira cun colegamënc. Les mudaziuns locales vën controledes coche conflits. I valorei dla fontana che manca vën ignorés; n null esplizit destuda l valor colegà.
sync-estimate-field-gitlab: Ciamp de stima sun chësc tofl
sync-estimate-field-gitlab-hint: Le pëis o la stima dl tëmp de GitLab vëgn scrita tl ciamp numerich che te chirjes. Les mudaziuns locales vëgn controlades desco conflits; n problem zënza pëis scancëla le valur colegá.
email-recovery-heading: Lista di messajes email da mandé
email-recovery-description: Na linia per vigni destinatèr. Chir cun l ID dl utent. L cuntenut di messajes y i ciampi cun la adresses email di destinatères ne vën nia mustrei. La pausa tegn ferm i messajes che ie bele y chëi che vën; reprënder proa da mandé sëura sen i messajes tla lista. Anulé scancëla i messajes metui tla lista nchin al mumënt dla dumanda. Sce l invié ie ocupà, proa inò do n curt tëmp. N messaje che vën bele mandà ne possa nia unì clamà zoruch, y n invié cun n resultat nia segur possa unì repetì. I fal permanënc y i messajes che à arjont l limit di tentatives resta a desposizion per la revijion. Proé inò i messajes nia mandai cun suzes taca n nuef cichl de tentatives y mantegn la pausa che ie bele.
email-recovery-attempts: Numer plu aut de tentatives repetii
email-recovery-pending: Tl aspeté o tl proé inò
email-recovery-empty: Degun messaje tla lista y degun destinatèr cun l invié en pausa.
email-recovery-unavailable: N ne possa nia liejer la lista di emails. Verifichëia l azes dl aministradour y la desponibilità dl server.
email-recovery-busy: N invié o n'autra operazion dla lista ie tlaur. Agiorna y proa inò do n curt tëmp.
email-recovery-failed: N ne à nia pudù cunfermé l'operazion. Agiorna la lista y proa inò la medema azion sce l ie de bujën.
email-recovery-superseded: N'azion plu nueva dl operadour à remplazà chësta dumanda. L vën mustrà l stat atuel dla lista.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Anulé duc i messajes che ie sen tla lista per chësc destinatèr? L cuntenut vën scancelà y ne possa nia unì recuperà. I messajes nueves creei do chësta dumanda vën mantignui.
email-recovery-retry: Proé inò i messajes nia mandai cun suzes
email-failure-smtp-temporary: Refudé da SMTP per n temp
email-failure-smtp-authentication: L autentificazion dla posta mëss unì controleda
email-failure-smtp-configuration: La configurazion dla posta mëss unì controleda
email-failure-recipient-unavailable: Destinatèr nia a desposizion o cunt desativé
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: L invié ne é nia stat meso cunfermé; controlé dan de proé danüef
email-failure-acknowledgement-failed: La ricevuda dl invié ne é nia unida salveda
email-failure-delivery-failed: L invié o la preparazion é falì
sync-time-estimate-hint: Les stimes dl temp daura i ciamps numerics dl temp original y dl temp che manca, creés dala importazion Jira. Te chësta tabela mëss ester apont n ciamp che corespon. Les mudaziuns locales vën controledes coche conflits; i valorei dla fontana che manca vën ignorés y n null esplizit destuda l valor.
sync-planning-hint: Sprint y publicazions vëgn sincronisá ma tan dî che Scrum é ativé sön chësc tofl. N sprint o na publicazion che mancia vëgn fat sön chësc tofl, cun les dates che la fontana dá; un che é bele vëgn assegné dan dut dal ID dla fontana, spo dal inom. Na mudaziun locala dla planificaziun resta cina che la fontana müda la planificaziun de chëra chestiun, y na pröma sincronisaziun ne tol mai demez planificaziun.
activity-recovery-description: L invié dles notificazions nia fenides vën prové danüef automaticamënter. Controlé les ativités che manca o che é mudedes dan de proé danüef. Proé danüef ne creëia mai danüef na atività.
activity-recovery-empty: Deguna notificazion de atività che speta.
activity-recovery-unavailable: Al ne é nia stat meso ciarié les notificazions de atività che speta.
activity-recovery-status-preparing: A speté n plan di destinatères
activity-recovery-status-inconsistent: L plan y l atività che speta ne corespon nia
activity-recovery-busy: N auter prozes laoura sun chësta notificazion. Agiorné y proé danüef.
activity-recovery-denied: L aces dl destinatèr o les preferënzes dles notificazions ne permet nia plu l invié.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: L atività originala manca o é mudeda. Al ne é nia unì creé danüef.
activity-recovery-disabled: Les notificazions de atività é desativées.
activity-recovery-failed: Al ne é nia stat meso fenì l invié dla notificazion. L laour che speta é unì mantenì.
activity-recovery-paused: L invié dles notificazions de atività é en pausa.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Chësta notificazion é mudeda da canche la é unida ciarieda. Controlé l stat agiorné dan de proé danüef.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Al ne é nia stat meso cunfermé l impostazion dl invié. Agiorné y controlé si stat atual.
activity-recovery-status-cancelled: L invié dles notificazions de atività é anulé.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Anulé definitivamënter l invié che manca per chësta atività? Al ne se pò nia continué do. Les e-mail bele tla coa y les notificazions bele manedes ne vën nia retirédes.
rule-email-recovery-description: Controlé i tentatifs registrés de invié e-mail dles regoles. I tentatifs nia cunfermés pò ester mo tl invié o interoc. Chësta relazion ne prova nia danüef y ne anulea nia l invié.
rule-email-recovery-identifiers: ID dl comand / dla invocazion / dl tentatif
rule-email-recovery-empty: Degun tentatif de e-mail dles regoles corespon a chësta chirida.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Al ne é nia stat meso ciarié i tentatifs de e-mail dles regoles. Agiorné per proé danüef.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: WeKan ne manda mai inò da se nstës na e-mail nia cunfermeda. L'invié inò va mé ai destinatars nia cunfermei. Marché coche invià sce sabeis che la ie ruvada, o anulé l'invié.
rule-email-recovery-wait: L'invié uriginel possa ëssa mo en curs. Podeis dezider do __time__.
rule-email-recovery-resend: Invié inò ai destinatars nia cunfermei
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Invié inò chësta e-mail ai destinatars nia cunfermei? Chi che si server de posta la à aceteda zënza avisè WeKan la ciafarà doi iedesc.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Marché chësta e-mail coche invià a duc? Fé chësc mé sce sabeis che la ie ruvada.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Anulé l'invié de chësta e-mail? La ne vegnirà nia invieda ai destinatars nia cunfermei.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: L'invié uriginel possa ëssa mo en curs. Pruevé inò plu tert.
rule-email-resolution-already-resolved: Chësta e-mail ie bele gnuda resulveda.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: N invié repetù de dant possa ëssa mo en curs. Pruevé inò plu tert.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Duc i destinatars ie bele cunfermei. Marché coche invià empë de inviè inò.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: L server de posta ne à nia respundù. La e-mail invieda inò possa ëssa ruvada o nia; la vën mustreda coche en curs.
rule-email-resolution-busy: N auter aministradëur ie dré a resolvé chësta e-mail. Pruevé inò danter puech.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: La e-mail salveda ne curespuend nia plu a chësc tentatif, donca ne possa la nia unì resulveda tlo.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: La registrazion salveda de chësc tentatif ne ie nia valida, donca ne possa l nia unì resulvù tlo.
rule-email-resolution-failed: L ne ie nia stat puscibl resolvé chësta e-mail. Ciarié inò y prué inò.
rule-email-legacy-heading: E-mails de regules che aspeta n cuntrol
rule-email-legacy-description: Chësta e-mails de regules ie gnudes preparedes da na verscion plu vedla de WeKan che ne à nia registré da ulache si cuntenut univa, donca ne les mandarà WeKan nia da se nstës. Cuntrolé danora sce l autëur dla regula à mo l dërt d'azès, y leghé la e-mail inò per la preparé inò da la ciarta coche la ie al mumënt, o scartéla.
rule-email-legacy-reason-details-snapsho: Detais dla ciarta da na verscion plu vedla
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Preparé inò chësta e-mail da la ciarta coche la ie al mumënt? Si cuntenut possa ëssa auter che chël preparé dant.
rule-email-legacy-discard-confirm: Scarté chësta e-mail? La ne vegnirà mai invieda.
rule-email-legacy-empty: Deguna e-mail de regules aspeta n cuntrol.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: L ne ie nia stat puscibl ciarié les e-mails de regules che aspeta n cuntrol. Ciarié la plata inò per prué inò.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: L autëur dla regula ne à nia plu azès a chësta ciarta, o la regula ie mudeda, donca ne possa la e-mail nia unì ligada inò. Podeis la scarté.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: L'ativité che à destedé chësta e-mail ie mudeda, donca ne possa la nia unì ligada inò. Podeis la scarté.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: La ciarta da ulache chësta e-mail univa ne ie nia plu a desposizion, donca ne possa la nia unì ligada inò. Podeis la scarté.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: L'esecuzion dla regula che à preparé chësta e-mail ne ie nia plu salveda, donca ne possa la nia unì ligada inò. Podeis la scarté.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Chësta e-mail ie bele gnuda invieda, pruveda a inviè o scarteda.
rule-email-legacy-not-legacy: Chësta e-mail ie bele gnuda ligada inò.
rule-email-legacy-failed: L ne ie nia stat puscibl fenì chësta azion. Ciarié inò y prué inò.
stuck-sync-operation-heading: Operaziuns de sincronisaziun dles listes che ne po nia gnì repetudes
stuck-sync-operation-description: Vignöna de chëstes operaziuns de sincronisaziun dles listes salvades s'à fermé a mez y ne po nia plü gnì conclüdia, ajache so lista é gnüda tuta demez, fata indô o configurada atramënter, o l'utënt che l'à metüda en movimënt à perdü le dërt de scrí. Tan dî che öna aspetëia, ne po chësta lista nia sincronisé. Smachëla via por lascé sincronisé indô la lista: les mudaziuns bele fates resta, les mudaziuns salvades che resta ne vëgn mai scrites, y la sincronisaziun dedô confrontëia indô la lista cun so fontana.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: La lista é gnüda tuta demez, fata indô o so impostazions de sincronisaziun é gnüdes mudades
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: L'utënt che l'à metüda en movimënt n'à nia plü le dërt de scrí sön döta la lista
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Salvada da na verjiun de WeKan plü vedla zënza ci che l'à metüda en movimënt
stuck-sync-operation-reason-intent-missi: La registraziun de chi che l'à metüda en movimënt mancia
stuck-sync-operation-reason-unknown: Ne n'é nia gnü da controlé sëgn
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: Ara po gnì repetuda sëgn y se conclüj da sé, porchël ne pòn nia la smaché via.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Smaché via chësta operaziun de sincronisaziun dla lista salvada? Les mudaziuns che ara à bele fat resta; le rest ne vëgn mai scrit. La lista po spo sincronisé indô.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: Degönes operaziuns de sincronisaziun dles listes aspetëia na revijiun.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: Al vëgn mostré ma les 50 plü vedles. Smachëia via valgönes y ajornëia por odëi deplü.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Les operaziuns de sincronisaziun dles listes ne n'é nia gnüdes da ciarié. Ajornëia por proé indô.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: Chësta operaziun ne n'é nia gnüda abinada blocada, porchël ne pòn nia la smaché via.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: Chësta operaziun po gnì repetuda sëgn y se conclüj da sé, porchël ne n'é ara nia gnüda smachada via.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: Chësta lista se sincroniseia sëgn. Próa indô danter n momënt.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: L ne ie nia stat puscibl fenì chësta azion. Ciarié inò y prué inò.
interrupted-import-heading: Importaziuns de tofles che s'à fermé dan la fin
interrupted-import-description: Vignöna de chëstes importaziuns de tofles s'à fermé a mez - le server é gnü inviè indô, o l'importaziun é falida - y à lascé n tofl parzial. N'importaziun ne po nia gnì portada inant, ajache so documënt de fontana ne vëgn nia tigní. Tëgn le tofl coche al é, o smachël via y importëia indô le documënt. Smaché via tol demez le tofl che chësta importaziun à fat y dut ci che é sön ël, ince dut ci che é gnü injunté da spo.
interrupted-import-state-discarding: Vëgn smachada via; smachëia via indô por la conclüje
interrupted-import-scrum: So pas Scrum à so punt de control (__state__, __next__ de __total__ pasc). Sce te tëgnes le tofl, conclüjel o smachel via dal recuperamënt dl'importaziun Scrum dl tofl.
interrupted-import-counts: __swimlanes__ stredes, __lists__ listes, __cards__ ciartes, __checklists__ listes de control, __comments__ comënc, __attachments__ injuntes
interrupted-import-no-board: Degün tofl ne n'é gnü fat
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Tigní chësc tofl parzial coche al é? Nia ne vëgn tut demez, y l'importaziun ne vëgn nia plü metüda sö chiló.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Smaché via chësta importaziun? Le tofl che ara à fat y dut ci che é sön ël vëgn tut demez por dagnora.
interrupted-import-empty: Degönes importaziuns de tofles interotes aspetëia na revijiun.
interrupted-import-truncated: Al vëgn mostré ma les 50 plü vedles. Tëgn o smachëia via valgönes y ajornëia por odëi deplü.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Les importaziuns de tofles interotes ne n'é nia gnüdes da ciarié. Ajornëia por proé indô.
interrupted-import-missing: Chësta importaziun ne n'é nia plü registrada.
interrupted-import-not-interrupted: Chësta importaziun n'aspetëia nia plü na dezijiun.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: Le tofl cun chësc ID ne n'é nia gnü fat da chësta importaziun, porchël ne n'él nia gnü tocé.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: So pas Scrum vëgn ciamò scrit o recuperé. Próa indô danter tröc menüc.
interrupted-import-failed: L ne ie nia stat puscibl fenì chësta azion. Ciarié inò y prué inò.
saml-login-not-started: Chësta registraziun SAML ne é nia unida metuda a jì te chësta scheda dl browser. Registrëive danüef.
history-request-pending-undo: Vosta ultima anulaziun ne é mo nia unida cunfermeda dal server.
history-request-pending-redo: Vosta ultima repetiziun ne é mo nia unida cunfermeda dal server.
history-request-hint: Proé danüef repët la medema domanda, y per chël ne pò nia anulé na segunda mudaziun.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: N desfà, refà o recuperamënt de mudaziuns Scrum s'à fermé pro n conflit. Les mudaziuns Scrum sön chësc tofl é blocades cina che al vëgn resolt.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: __applied__ de __total__ mudaziuns é gnüdes scrites, __pending__ nia, y __conflicted__ é gnüdes mudades da n'ater da spo.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Jí zoruch mët vigni registraziun mudada coche ara ê denant; al vëgn ofert ma sce degügn atri à mudé chëres registraziuns da spo. Tigní le tofl coche al é tol demez l'operaziun fermada y ne müda degöna registraziun. Te vigni caje vëgnel registré te Panel d'aministrazion, Problemi, Recuperamënt.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard: Tigní le tofl coche al é
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Tigní vigni registraziun coche ara é sëgn, ince les mudaziuns che l'operaziun fermada à bele scrit?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: N aministradú dl tofl po jí zoruch o tigní le tofl coche al é.
login-setting-clear-secret: Scancelé le valur salvé tl panel d’aministrazion
login-setting-after-restart: À efet do avëi inviè indô WeKan
login-setting-env-only: Ma l'ambiënt dl server les imposta. Chiló vëgnes ma mostrades da lì.
email-to-card-description: N e-mail mandà al’adressa de tua tofl devënta na ciarta sun chëla tofl.
email-to-card-webhook: URL dl webhook en entrada dl fornidëur de posta (Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark o n relé MIME crù)
email-to-card-secret-saved: Salvé - lascé vet per l tenì
email-to-card-clear-secret: Gaué l secret dl webhook salvé
email-to-card-sandstorm-board: Tofl olache va la posta mandeda a chësc grain
email-to-card-sandstorm-board-none: Deguna - mé e-mails cun n token dla tofl tl argumënt
email-to-card-sandstorm-subject: Met chësc tl argumënt per arjonjer chësta tofl coche te nstës:
email-to-card-part-strip-quoted: Lascé demez i messaghes de denant citei
email-to-card-part-sender-line: Rie dl mandant sun l prinzipie dla descrizion
email-to-card-your-address: Tua adressa e-mail per chësta tofl
email-to-card-address-private: Tienl privat: chiche l à possa junté ciartes sciche te.
email-to-card-new-address: Indirizz nuef (chël vedl ne va nia plu)
email-to-card-member-enabled: I mi indirizc dla tofles va
email-to-card-off-admin-off: L giaurì e-mails ne n’ie nia mpustà tl Panel de aministrazion.
email-to-card-off-board-off: N aministradëur dla tofl ne n'à nia ativà la posta per chësta tofl.
email-to-card-off-member-off: Te es desativà tua adresses dla tofles tla Mpustazions dl mëmber.
email-to-card-off-sandstorm-no-session: L grain ne à mo nia si adressa e-mail. Ciaria inò la plata.
email-to-card-off-not-authorized: Te ës debojegn dl acess de scritura a chësta tofl.
inbound-domain-invalid: Chësc ne n'é nia n inom de domine valid.
inbound-domain-required: Dà l domine di indirizc dla tofles.
inbound-account-invalid: Na ciassela IMAP à debojegn de n inom de server valid.
feature-views-email-desc: La tofl coche cassela de posta: la lista de e-mails ie la Posta che rua, la listes ie ordinadëures, la etichetes ie etichetes, y i mëmbri scrij y respuend ai e-mails dal’adressa dla tofl.
email-view-not-receiving: Chësta tofl ne giaura mo nia e-mails. Ativea chësc tla Mpustazions dla notificazions dla tofl → E-mail te ciarta.
email-view-invalid-address: Una dla adresses ne n’ie nia n’adressa e-mail valida.
email-view-too-many: Massa e-mail mandades tl'ultima ora. Proa danü plu tert.
email-view-no-list: La tofl à debojegn de na lista por la posta.
email-view-send-failed: L e-mail ne n’à nia pudù vester mandà.
feature-views-chat-desc: La tofl sciche spazi de ciacolada: spazi de laur, tofli, stredes, listes y ciartes sciche n ber de canai, la ciarta tl mez y si coments sciche messajes de ciacolada.
chat-view-message-cards: Mostra ma les ciartes con messajes
chat-view-pick-card: Cerni na ciarta dai canai por la odëi chiló.
chat-view-no-messages: Ćiamò nia de messajes. Scrí le pröm.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Les medemes ciartes te plü grups de colones cun inom - do complemënt, prioritê, tapa o val' d'ater - spostades danter colones cun le tré.
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Menù dla tabla → Regoles conseia regoles da chel che la jënt fej a man for indô.
feature-board-summary-desc: Menù dla tabla → Sintesa mostra chël che vignun à fat su la tabla l ultim dì o l'ultima edema, y chël che à en retard.
feature-since-last-visit: Dal tuo ultimo jì a ciaf
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Menù dla tabla → Dal tuo ultimo jì a ciaf mostra chël che d'autri à mudà su la tabla.
feature-search-phrases-desc: La chirida globala capësc frases scemples sciche "mi chertes en retard".
column-sets-empty: Ciamò degügn grups de colones. N aministradëur dl tofl po fá un: dài n inom, spo ajonta sües colones.
feature-views-version-control-desc: La tofla sciöche n tracker de problems GitHub o Gitea: ciartes sciöche problems, etichetes y tapes, comënc sciöche conversaziun, injuntes sciöche files y la storia dla tofla cun desfé.
vcs-no-issues: Degügn problem ne corespogn a chësta cërcia.
vcs-no-milestones: Ciamò degöna tapa. N'etiheta cun scadënza é na tapa.
vcs-issue-title-required: N problem à debojëgn de n titul.
vcs-no-list: Chësta tofla n'à degöna lista o corsia por le problem.
card-qr-code-desc: Scanerëde por daurí chësta ciarta sön n telefonin o tablet.
card-qr-code-too-long: Le link de chësta ciarta é massa lunch por n code QR.
vcs-no-wiki: Ćiamò degun wiki. La importaziun de n’organisaziun GitHub porta ca le wiki de n archif de codesc.
github-org-import-desc: Vigni archif de codesc de n’organisaziun o de n utënt deventa süa tofla, daurida te Board View / Version Control: si problems cun comënc, etichetes y files, sües publicaziuns, si workflows GitHub Actions sciöche regules, y so wiki.
github-org-import-token-hint: Ad ö por archifs de codesc privac y n limit API plü alt. Al vëgn adoré ma intratan la importaziun y nia mai salvé.
github-org-import-issues: Problems, cun comënc, etichetes y files
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Scrí le inom de n’organisaziun o de n utënt, o so indirizz GitHub.
github-org-import-no-repos: Degun archif de codesc da importé.
github-org-import-running: Na importaziun de n’organisaziun é bele en cors.
optional-apis-desc: API REST te la forma dles API d'atri tracker, ajache sües aplicaziuns y scripts pois adoré chësc WeKan sciöche backend: ci che ai salva vëgn tigní te WeKan, sön tofles de WeKan. Vignöna é destodada cina ch'ara vëgn marcada chilò. Degöna n'à dërc da süa pert: n client se lëia ite cun n token API de WeKan y po odëi y mudé ma ci che chëra porsona po odëi y mudé te WeKan. Dötes adoress che la API REST de WeKan sides ativada (WITH_API=true). L'indirizz sot a vignöna é ci che n client adora sciöche so server.
optional-api-trello-desc: Aplicaziuns y scripts scrić por la API REST de Trello (por ejëmpl Trellinator) funziona cun WeKan: tofles, listes, ciartes, etichetes, mëmbri, comënc y listes de control. Le token de Trello é n token API de WeKan. Scancelé na ciarta la sposta tl archif de WeKan.
optional-api-jira-desc: I clients dla API REST v2 de Jira funziona cun WeKan: n proiet é na tofla (süa tlé é la tlé dla tofla), n problem é na ciarta (DEV-7), n stato é na lista, y na transiziun sposta la ciarta. La crida azeta JQL scemple: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text y ORDER BY. Lëiede ite cun n token API de WeKan sciöche parola secreta. Scancelé n problem le sposta tl archif.
optional-api-github-desc: I clients dla API REST de GitHub por problems funziona cun WeKan: n archif de codesc é na tofla, n problem é na ciarta, cun etichetes, tapes (etichetes cun data de scadënza), comënc, y daurí o stlüt sciöche te Vijion dla tofl / Control dles verscions. Le token é n token API de WeKan.
optional-api-gitea-desc: I clients dla API REST de Gitea y Forgejo por problems funziona cun WeKan, tl medem codesc dla API compatibla cun GitHub: n archif de codesc é na tofla y n problem é na ciarta. Le token é n token API de WeKan.
bots-none: Ancora degun bot. N bot é n esecutor sun tie server - n agent IA, n lëur CI, n script - a chël che chësta tofl dà ciartes.
bot-not-found: Chel bot n'é nia sun chësta tofl.
bot-option-not-found: Chela resposta n'é nia una de chëres che l bot à porté.
webhook-internal-hosts-desc: I webhook in uscita ne pò nia rové pro adresses dla rei de WeKan instëssa, ajache degügn ne pois mëte le webhook de na tofla sön n sorvisc intern. Scrí ca i host de chësta rei che i webhook pò rové pro - n Node-RED, n server de chat - un por riga, sciöche inom o adressa, cun na porta por lascé tres ma chëla porta. Vëit: degügn. Ma i aministradus dl sit pò mudé chësta lista.
account-webhook: Webhook de azes y de registrazion
account-webhook-desc: N indirizo che WeKan avisa canche zachei fej l azes o canche vëgn fat n account nuef. Nia ne vëgn mandé enfin che n evenimënt dessot ne n'é nia marché. Al porta l evenimënt, l inom utënt y l'ora; marchëde d'autri ciamps mé sce l destinatar ti adora.
account-webhook-on-register: Canche vëgn fat n account nuef
account-webhook-field-ip: Indirizo IP da olache l azes é gnü
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: Anulé dötes les notificazions de atività che speta, plü vedles che cotan de dis?
activity-recovery-bulk-result: Anulades %s, inviades %s, %s plü vedles che speta ciamò.
vcs-synced-from: Sincronisé da %s: daurí y stlü le ilò.
vcs-synced-issue: Chësc problem é sincronisé: daurí y stlü le te so sistem.
sync-write-back: Scrì zeruch les mudazions a GitLab: titul, descrizion, coments, sarada y daurida danef
sync-write-back-error: Scrì zeruch a GitLab ne n'é nia jit
email-bounces-description: Cie che WeKan fej cun i e-mails che torna zeruch: n’adressa scrita mel, na cassela plëina, na resposta de assënza, n reclam de spam. Uni sort à si azions, fates canche l ie turnà zeruch tan de iedes.
email-bounces-enabled: Gestí les mail tornades zeruch te WeKan
email-bounces-action-stop-email: Ne mandé plu mail a chesta adressa
email-bounces-action-notify-inviter: Dì a chi che l'à invedà
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: L'adressa ne esist nia: n fal de scritura, n cont scancelé, n domine nia cognosciù.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: Nia consegnada per śen: caseta piena, server ocupé. Demè tantes te fila vuel dì zeche.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Respostes de assenza, de vacanza o de n sistem de ticket. La mail é stata consegnada.
email-bounces-category-complaint-desc: L destinatar à segnà la mail coche spam.
email-bounces-ses-description: Te Amazon SES, mandé les notifiches Bounce y Complaint, y na regola de receziun per l'adressa da olache WeKan manda, a n tema SNS, y abonede chesta adressa a chel tres HTTPS:
email-bounces-ses-topics: ARN di temes SNS da azeté, un per riga
email-bounces-stopped-only: Demè les adresses a chëres che WeKan ne manda plu mail
email-bounces-clear-hint: Desmentié i retorns de chesta adressa y i mandé indò mail
email-bounce-invalid-topic: Chest ne n'é nia n ARN de tema SNS.
email-bounces-providers-description: Sce WeKan spediësc tres un de chisc servizs, l'ativëia, da al servize chësta adressa webhook por si events de mail tornades zeruch y reclams de spam, y taca ite chilò la tle cun chëra che al les firma, o la parola de acess che t'as metù te l'adressa sciöche https://user:password@… o ?secret=…
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: N servize ativé à de besëgn de si tle de firma o de si parola de acess.
activity-pub-enabled: I tofli publics publichëia la ativité de si ciartes tl fediverse (ActivityPub)
activity-pub-desc: Destudé de default. Canche al ie ativé, vigni tofl public possa unì perseguità da Mastodon y d'autri server dl fediverse coche @board-<id> pra l'adressa de chësc WeKan, y la neva ativité dla ciartes ruva a si perseguitadëures. Al ie mé da lieje: nia de chël che n server dl fediverse mana muda n tofl, y i tofli privac ne vën mai publicà.
caldav-sync-desc: Met la dates de scadënza dla ciartes de chësc tofl te n calendario - Nextcloud Calendar o n calendario CalDAV kei che sibe. Na data de scadënza spustëda tl calendario toma zeruch tla ciarta. Adurëia na parola secreta dl'aplicazion, no la tia.
caldav-enabled: Sincronisé la dates de scadënza cun chësc calendario
caldav-invalid-url: L'adressa dl calendario muessa vester n'adressa http:// o https://, zënza inuem dl utënt o parola secreta ite.
caldav-not-linked: Salvé dant n'adressa dl calendario y ativé la sincronisazion.
webdav-storage-description: Salva la injuntes te na cartela sun n server WebDAV - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud o n auter. Adurëia na parola secreta dl'aplicazion fata per WeKan. N server sun la rë de WeKan nstës possa unì adurà chiò, ajache mé n aministradëur dl sit tol ju chësta adressa.
sqrl-desc: Destudà da sorandesëura. Canche al ie impià, la plata d'azes pieta SQRL, y i commembri ajontea dant si identità SQRL tles Impostazions dl commember. SQRL ie de bujën che WeKan sibe a n adrëc https://.
sqrl-scan: Scansionëia l codesc cun ti app SQRL, o giauri ti client SQRL sun chësc aparat.
sqrl-expired: Chësc codesc SQRL ie scadù. Scumëncia da nuef.
sqrl-sign-in-failed: L azes cun SQRL ne n'ie nia jit.
sqrl-needs-https: SQRL ie de bujën che WeKan sibe a n adrëc https://.
sqrl-description: Fej azes cun ti identità SQRL al post de na parola secreta. Ajontela ilò n iede cun ti client SQRL; te la pos tò demez ilò canche te ues.
sqrl-none: Nia identità SQRL ne n'ie ajonteda.
sqrl-disabled-by-client: L azes cun SQRL ie destudà per chësc account da ti client SQRL. Impiëlo inò ilò cun ti codesc de salvamënt.
sqrl-only-on: Ti client SQRL à blucà chësc account sun SQRL: uni autra maniera de fé azes vën refudeda.
sqrl-hardlock-on: Ti client SQRL à blucà dl dut chësc account: l ripristin dla parola secreta y la mudazion dl e-mail vën refudei.

enrollment-confirmed-instructions: L code de confermazion é bele stat adorà. Speta n code nuef te tie autenticadëur dant che jì ite.

feature-person-wip-limit-desc: Tan de ciartes davertes che una na persona possa tenì sun na tofl; na ciarta daverta avisa de vigni un sura. Metù per tofl te Mpustazions dla tofl / Lista.

feature-retrospective-board-desc: La tofl de retrospectiva tl menu dla tofl: na tofl privata nueva cun les listes Scomencé a fé, Ressé de fé, Jì inant a fé y Atività da fé. Ala se destuda per vigni tofl tles sues Mpustazions de Scrum.

feature-split-lists-desc: Na lista spartida te Tl laour y Fat: na ciarta marcheda sciche fata ilò aspieta, stluda, de vegnì trata te la lista do, y l cë dla lista conta dutes does. Lascé per tofl te Mpustazions dla tofl / Lista, spo da mëter en funzion tl menù de vigni lista.
workload-intro: Les ores stimedes y i ponc dles storia dles ciartes assegnedes a uni persona, edema per edema, cunfrontedes cun les ores che ala à: si temp de lëur, assenzes y dis de festa publics. Clichea sun n'edema per udëi sies ciartes.
workload-truncated: Massa da mostré deboriada: l rapport mostra mé les prumes persones y ciartes. Cernì manco edemes o manco tofles.
workload-allocations-intro: Tan dl temp de na persona che va a na tofla, o ciuni roi che na tofla adurerà dant che zachei vegne numinà.
workload-invalid-estimate: La stima muss vester danter 0 y 10000 ores.
feature-workload-desc: Cëria de lëur y capazità tl menù dl utënt: ores stimedes y ponc dles storia dles ciartes de uni persona, edema per edema, cunfrontedes cun si temp de lëur, assenzes y dis de festa publics, cun assegnazions a tofles y roi provisores.
billing-intro: I tofli olache t'es aministradëur: si budget, tan che si lëur à custà y cuschterà cun i prisc da ora che t'ës metù, y fatures dla ores fates. Mé i aministradëures di tofli ve oda.
billing-no-boards: Ne t'es aministradëur de deguna tofla.
billing-unrated: __hours__ h ne à nia n priesc da ora y ne n'ie nia caluledes. Met n priesc per la tofla o per chëla persones.
billing-nothing-to-invoice: Uni ora da faturé ie bele faturada.
billing-set-rate-first: Met dant n priesc da ora per chësta tofla.
feature-billing-desc: Budget y fatures tl menu dl utënt: l budget de na tofla en scioldi o ores, prisc da ora, i cosc y la previjion de si lëur, y fatures dla ores da faturé fates. Mé i aministradëures di tofli l oda.
billing-include-undated: Tò ite l tëmp registrà dant che les dates gnisse tignudes
billing-method-link: Colegamënt de paiament (chertina, portafoi, paiament online)

billing-uncosted: __hours__ h ne à degun cosć per ora y ne n'ie nia tl cosć.

billing-approve-time: Aprové l tëmp dan che al vegne faturé
billing-fees-intro: Na tapa o n priesc fis vegn faturé n iede, da si di inant; n paiamënt mensil uni mëns da si di nfin a si fin.
billing-unapproved: __hours__ h aspieta l'aprovazion y ne n'ie nia sun chësta fatura.

billing-accept-sets-budget: N'oferta azetada doventa l preventif dla tofla

cloud-panel-settings-intro: Te la Domëne dl Cloud Panel tën le SuperAdmin les domënes di clienc, sües banches dac, le DNS de CloudFlare y les strades de Caddy, y vignun client vëiga sües fatures y rejona cun le SuperAdmin. Le SuperAdmin é n aministradù de WeKan che é bele.

cloud-panel-dns-conflict: __name__ à bele n record __type__: al vëgn lascé coche al é.
cloud-panel-caddy-intro: Caddy mëna la Domëne dl Cloud Panel y vigni domëna sparteda a chësc WeKan, y vigni domëna cun süa banca dac a so container WeKan.
cloud-panel-caddy-admin: Adrëcia dl'API de aministraziun de Caddy

cloud-panel-database-uri: Stringa de conesciun (o les pertes dessot)
cloud-panel-customers: Clienc che s'anunzia chiló (inuems d'utënt o adrëces e-mail)
cloud-panel-domain-cloudflare: Tigní so record DNS pro CloudFlare

cloud-admin-not-allowed: Cloud Admin él mé tl'ndirizh che la variabla d'ambient CLOUD dl server dij, por si aministrëures Cloud y por i cliënc di dominies che al nominea.
cloud-allowed-addresses-desc: I ndirizhes IPv4 y IPv6, y i raiuns de ndirizhes desco 203.0.113.0/24, dan olache n aministrëur Cloud pó se registrè. Un por röia. Vüt: valgügn ndirizh.
cloud-allowed-addresses-lockout: Tüa ndirizh __address__ n'él nia te chësta lista. Sö salvè te serëssa fora, dessura n'él nia salvà.
admin-panel-allowed-addresses-desc: I ndirizi IPv4 y IPv6 y i intervai de ndirizi, un per riga, da olache an possa adurvé l Panel d'aministrazion y la API REST d'aministrazion. Vuet: ciuldi ndirizh.
admin-panel-allowed-addresses-env: La variabla dl ambient dl server ADMIN_PANEL_ALLOWED_IP_ADDRESSES dezid al post de chësta lista.
admin-panel-address-refused: L Panel d'aministrazion ne possa nia gnì adurvé da tüa ndirizh __address__.

feature-views-shop-desc: I prodoc sun les ciartes de na tofla sciöche botega web: na ciarta cun n pretl é n prodot, sües etichetes é les categories y n'ordinaziun é na ciarta tla lista Ordinaziuns. Na tofla publica po se daurì te chësta vijion, insciö che i vijitadus cumpra al'adresa dla tofla.

shop-prices-include-vat: I pretli tol ite la IVA
shop-sale-lists: Listes en venüda (degöna sorantada: vignü lista fora che la lista Ordinaziuns)
shop-category-labels: Etichetes mostrades sciöche categories (degöna sorantada: vignü etiketa)
shop-orders-private: Les ordinaziuns vëgn scrites sön na tofla privata, ajache na tofla publica mostra vignü ciarta a vignün.
shop-guest-checkout: I vijitadus zënza conto po ordiné
shop-show-on-public: Mostrè la Botega impede la tofla publica
shop-show-on-public-note: Na tofla publica se dàuria te na vijion sola. Sce an tol ca la Botega, sostitësc ara __view__ por i vijitadus, y sce an tol Sit web o n'atra vijion te Mpustazions dla tofla / Vijion dla tofla, sostitësc chësc la Botega.
shop-empty: Ciamò degügn prodoc. Na ciarta cun n pretl te na lista en venüda é n prodot.
shop-privacy-note: Tü inom y tües informaziuns de contat vëgn scrites sön l'ordinaziun, acioche la botega la posses consegné, y ingn'olache d'ater.
shop-price-changed: N pretl s'à mudé. Contrlëia le total nü y ordinëia indô.
shop-confirmation-email: Mané al compradú na confermaziun dl'ordinaziun por e-mail
import-board-instruction-wordpress: Te WordPress tol 'Tools', 'Export', 'All content' y 'Download Export File', y tol chël file .xml chiló, o taca ite so test. Squarespace, Wix y d'atri sic che esporta n file WordPress va al medemo vers. Uni plata y uni articul deventa na ciarta tla lista de so stat, les plates tla streda Pages y i articui te Posts, cun so contignü, categories y tags sciöche etichetes, y si comënc aprovà.
import-board-instruction-wordpressjson: Salvëia i articui y les plates dla WordPress REST API (/wp-json/wp/v2/posts y /wp-json/wp/v2/pages) sciöche n file .json, y tol le chiló o taca le ite. Uni plata y uni articul deventa na ciarta tla lista de so stat.
import-board-instruction-ghost: Te Ghost tol 'Settings', 'Labs', 'Export your content', y tol le file .json chiló o taca le ite. Uni plata y uni articul deventa na ciarta tla lista de so stat, cun si tags sciöche etichetes.
import-board-instruction-blogger: Te Blogger tol 'Settings', 'Back up content', y tol le file .xml chiló o taca ite so test. Uni articul y uni plata deventa na ciarta, na mineta tla lista Draft, cun si etichetes y comënc.
import-board-instruction-markdownsite: Comprim te n .zip les fontanes de n sit Hugo, Jekyll, Eleventy, Astro o de n d'atri sit statich - i file Markdown cun so front matter, y sües images - y tol le .zip chiló. Uni file Markdown deventa na ciarta: articui dai ordinadus posts o cun na data tl inom dl file, le rest plates, minetes tla lista Draft, y les images che al adora sciöche sües injuntes.
import-board-instruction-htmlsite: Comprim te n .zip i file de n sit web - sües plates .html y images, sciöche salvades cun wget o HTTrack, o l'esportaziun de Medium - y tol le .zip chiló. Uni plata deventa na ciarta cun so test prinzipal, y les images che ara adora sciöche sües injuntes; scripts, menù y formulars vëgn lasciá fora.
import-board-instruction-substack: Te Substack tol 'Settings', 'Exports', 'Create new export', y tol le .zip descariché chiló. Uni articul deventa na ciarta cun so test, publiché o mineta.
help-board-view-swimlanes-what-it-is-des: Swimlanes divide the board into horizontal bands, so each card belongs to both a list and a swimlane. A lane can stand for a team, a person, a customer or a kind of work, while the lists keep showing the stages of the work.
help-board-view-swimlanes-how-it-works-d: Click + in a swimlane header, or choose Add Swimlane in its menu, type a name and choose whether it goes above or below the selected lane. Pasting several lines can create one swimlane per line. Click a name to rename it, use the caret to collapse or expand a lane, drag its handle to reorder lanes, and drag its bottom edge to change its height unless a board admin has locked resizing.
help-board-view-lists-what-it-is-descrip: Lists are the columns that hold the cards. On a kanban board each list is a stage of the work, and a card moves from list to list as the work goes on. In Swimlanes view a list can belong to one swimlane.
help-board-view-lists-how-it-works-descr: Click the add list icon at the right end of a list header, or Add in the list menu, type a name and choose which list it comes after; pasting several lines can create one list per line. Click a list title to rename it, and the caret in its header collapses or expands it just for you. The list menu also has copy, move and archive, and you can drag the handle between lists to resize them when resizing is allowed.
help-board-view-table-what-it-is-descrip: The Table view shows the board's cards as a spreadsheet-like table, one row per card, with its list, swimlane, people, labels and dates. It is handy for scanning many cards at once and for adding or moving cards without dragging them across lists.
help-board-view-table-how-it-works-descr: Click a column header to sort, and click it again to reverse the order. Type in the search box to match card titles, lists, swimlanes and labels, and use Previous and Next to page through 25 rows at a time. The Edit button opens a card over the table. Wrap titles and Group by swimlane change the layout and are remembered in this browser. Archived cards are left out, and the sidebar Filter narrows the rows.
help-board-view-cal-what-it-is-descripti: The Calendar view places the board's cards on a calendar by their dates: a card with start and end dates as a bar between them, and its received, due and end dates as their own entries. Dated checklist items appear too.
help-board-view-cal-how-it-works-descrip: Use Today, Previous and Next to move around, and switch between day, week and month, each as a grid or a list. Drag a card to give it a new due date, or stretch it to change its end date. Click a day, or drag over hours in the week or day grid, to create a new card due then; it goes to the board's first swimlane and first list.
help-board-view-calendar-mode-what-it-is: Calendar Mode shows each card on the day of its due date, with its labels and full title, in a month or week grid. It is a read-only overview of what is due when, similar to the Trello calendar.
help-board-view-calendar-mode-how-it-wor: Use Today, Previous and Next to move by a month or a week, and Week or Month to switch the grid; the choice is remembered in this browser. Click a card to open it. Archived cards are left out and the sidebar Filter applies. To change dates by dragging, use the Calendar view instead.
help-board-view-multiboard-cal-what-it-i: Multi Board Calendar shows the dated cards of every board you are a member of in one calendar, so you can see everything due this week no matter which board it is on. Each entry starts with its board's title in brackets.
help-board-view-multiboard-cal-how-it-wo: Open it from the Board View menu of any board and wait until the cards of all your boards have loaded. Use Today, Previous and Next and the day, week and month views, each also as a list. Received, due and end dates get their own entries. Click an entry to open that card on its board. Dates cannot be dragged here.
help-board-view-time-what-it-is-descript: The Time view gathers the board's time tracking in one place: how much time has been spent, by whom and on which cards, and how much time is left until cards are due. Time is entered on the cards themselves; this view only reports it.
help-board-view-time-how-it-works-descri: Read the time spent summary at the top, then the breakdown by assignee and by card, with overtime cards marked. Below it every change to a card's recorded hours is listed by the person who made it. Click Export to save the report as PDF or Excel. Members who may only see cards assigned to them get the summary for their own cards, while the other sections stay empty.
help-board-view-timeline-what-it-is-desc: The Timeline view shows the board as it was at an earlier moment, using the board's history. It helps you see what changed and put a card back the way it was.
help-board-view-timeline-how-it-works-de: Click a point on the line to see each card as it was then, grouped by its list at that time, with its title, description, labels, members and due date. Click Now to return to the present. On a card, Restore to this state sets those values back after you confirm. Nothing is deleted: the restore is recorded as new history, and the button is shown only to people who may change that card.
help-board-view-stats-what-it-is-descrip: Statistics shows the board's status at a glance: how its cards are loaded and how many swimlanes, lists, cards, archived cards, labels, members and custom fields it has.
help-board-view-stats-how-it-works-descr: Open Statistics from the Overview group of the Board View menu and read the Board status table. Card loading tells whether this board loads only the visible cards or all cards, and whether that was chosen automatically for a big board. The counts are computed on the server, so they are right even on a large board. Any value can be selected and copied, and opening the view changes nothing.
help-board-view-group-by-assignee-what-i: Group by Assignee lists every card under the person it is assigned to, instead of under its list, so you can see who has what without opening each list. It suits a team meeting.
help-board-view-group-by-assignee-how-it: Open it from the Board View menu. Each assignee gets a section with their cards, the due date where one is set and a clock when a card is over time; cards without an assignee are under No assignee. Click a card title to open the card. The grouping uses the card's Assignee field, not its Members. People whose role only lets them see cards assigned to them get no data here.
help-board-view-gantt-what-it-is-descrip: The Gantt views draw the board's cards on a calendar so you can see what starts, what is due and what overlaps. Gantt is a table with one row per card and an icon for each of its dates, while Frappe Gantt and DHTMLX Gantt draw each card as a bar from start to end.
help-board-view-gantt-how-it-works-descr: Choose Gantt, Frappe Gantt or DHTMLX Gantt in the Calendar and time group of the Board View menu; cards need at least one received, start, due or end date. In Gantt, each week with dates gets its own table; click a card name to open the card or a date icon to edit that date. In Frappe Gantt and DHTMLX Gantt, members with write access can drag a bar to reschedule the card.
help-board-view-product-backlog-what-it-: The Product Backlog is the ordered list of work a Scrum team has not yet taken into a sprint. It shows the board's cards that have no current sprint, ordered by backlog rank, without moving them out of their lists.
help-board-view-product-backlog-how-it-w: Find a card in the table and, in its Actions cell, set its Sprint, Backlog rank, Release, Work item type and Acceptance criteria, then click Save. Smaller ranks come first. Hold Ctrl, or Cmd on a Mac, to put a card in several releases. Click a card title to open the card, and Show more to load the next 100 cards. Editing follows the usual card permissions.
help-board-view-sprints-what-it-is-descr: A sprint is a short, fixed period in which a Scrum team finishes a chosen set of work toward a goal. The Sprints view is where the board's sprints are planned, started, closed or cancelled, along with its releases and Scrum events.
help-board-view-sprints-how-it-works-des: A board admin first opens Scrum settings, turns on Scrum planning and chooses the estimate source, unit, completion policy and working days. Then create a planned sprint with a name, goal, start and end, assign cards to it from the Product Backlog, and click Start sprint. To finish, choose where unfinished work goes and click Close sprint, or give a reason and click Cancel sprint. Only board admins manage sprints.
help-board-view-sprint-report-what-it-is: A sprint report tells what happened in one closed sprint: what was committed, completed, added, removed and left unfinished. Velocity lists those results for every closed sprint, so the next sprint can be planned from what the team really did.
help-board-view-sprint-report-how-it-wor: In Sprint Report, choose a sprint and choose Cards or Estimate above the bars, then read the daily scope and remaining work and the change-by-change history below. In Velocity, read one row per closed sprint. Results come from snapshots taken when each sprint started and closed, so later estimate changes do not rewrite them. Export saves the results as PDF or Excel, and Refresh reloads the report.
help-board-view-burndown-what-it-is-desc: These Scrum charts show progress over time. Burndown shows how much work is left day by day and Burnup how much is done, Velocity shows how much each closed sprint completed, Release Burndown follows the work left in a release, and Epic Progress shows how far parent cards have come.
help-board-view-burndown-how-it-works-de: Choose the chart under Scrum in the Board View menu. Each draws from the board's own cards and sprints and shows the numbers in a table under the chart. Velocity needs at least one closed sprint, and lets you choose Cards or Estimate. Click Export at the top to save the same numbers as PDF or Excel. A chart with nothing to draw yet says No results.
help-board-view-roadmap-what-it-is-descr: The Roadmap groups cards into rows by the value of a custom field, such as a release or an epic, and draws each row's cards on a timeline. It is useful for a release or theme roadmap when that grouping is already kept in a custom field.
help-board-view-roadmap-how-it-works-des: The board needs at least one text or dropdown custom field. Choose the field in Group by at the top; each value gets its own small Gantt chart of its cards, and cards without a value are grouped under No value. Cards are placed by their dates, so give them start and due dates to see them on the timeline.
help-board-view-dashboard-what-it-is-des: These Overview charts answer how busy the board is and how its work is spread: Dashboard and Pulse summarize the board, Workload shows who has what, Distribution how cards are divided, Dependency Map how cards block or depend on each other, and Activity Heatmap when people work on the board.
help-board-view-dashboard-how-it-works-d: Choose a chart in the Overview group of the Board View menu. Each page draws the chart from the board's cards and history and shows the table of numbers behind it. Click Export at the top to save the same data as PDF or Excel. When there is nothing to draw yet, the chart says No results.
help-board-view-bigboard-what-it-is-desc: Bigboard stacks every board you are a member of on one scrollable page, each with its own lists and cards, so you can work on all your boards at once.
help-board-view-bigboard-how-it-works-de: Open Bigboard from the Board View menu and wait while every board's cards load. Each board section works like a normal board: drag cards between lists, open cards and edit lists. You can also drag a card into a list of another board on the page, which moves it to that board. Lists can only be dragged within their own board. Click a board's title to open it on its own.
help-board-view-flow-what-it-is-descript: The Kanban flow charts show how work moves through the board: cumulative flow, control and cycle time, lead time, flow efficiency, throughput, WIP, aging work, blockers, forecasts of when work will be done, process behavior and whether bigger estimates take longer. They help you find where work piles up and how long it really takes.
help-board-view-flow-how-it-works-descri: Choose a chart in the Kanban flow group of the Board View menu. Read the note under the title, which says how it measures, then the chart and the table under it. Some pages take settings, such as target cards and date for Monte Carlo Forecasts or the size field for Work Item Size vs. Cycle Time, applied with Apply. Export at the top saves the tables as PDF or Excel.
help-board-view-reports-what-it-is-descr: These reports show how work flows through the board week by week: cards created and finished, net flow, how long cards stay in each list, the average age of open cards, the weekly throughput and how often due dates are met.
help-board-view-reports-how-it-works-des: Choose a report in the Kanban flow group of the Board View menu: Created vs. Resolved, Net Flow, Time in List, Average Age, Throughput Run Chart or Due Date Performance. Each shows a chart and, under it, the table of numbers it is drawn from. Click Export at the top to save that table as PDF or Excel.
help-board-view-map-what-it-is-descripti: The Map view shows the board's cards as markers on an image the board admin uploads, such as a floor plan or site map. It suits work that happens in places, like rooms, machines or plots.
help-board-view-map-how-it-works-descrip: A board admin clicks Upload a map image and chooses a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP file, and can remove it later without losing the card places. People who may change the board see the cards that are not on the map yet; drag one onto the image, or choose it and click where it belongs, and drag a marker to move it. A marker takes the colour of the card's first label, and clicking it opens the card.
help-board-view-email-what-it-is-descrip: The Email view shows the board as a mailbox: cards are the messages, lists are the folders and labels are the labels. You can write and answer email from the board's own address, so replies come back to the board as cards and comments.
help-board-view-email-how-it-works-descr: Click Inbox, Sent, All mail, a list or a label to choose what is shown, type in the search box to narrow the rows, and click a row to open the card, whose comments are the conversation. Compose writes a new email and the reply arrow answers one, sent from the board's address. The board must first receive email, turned on in the board's Notification Settings under Email to card.
help-board-view-chat-what-it-is-descript: The Chat view shows the board as a chat workspace: each card with a conversation is a channel and its comments are the messages. The channel tree covers every board you can see, with the number of messages you have not read.
help-board-view-chat-how-it-works-descri: Open a workspace and a board in Channels and click a card; it opens in the middle pane and its messages in the chat pane. Type a message and press Enter or click Send; Shift+Enter starts a new line. To start a conversation on a card with no messages, click Show all cards for that board and pick the card. The panes are mirrored for right-to-left languages.
help-board-view-version-control-what-it-: The Version Control view shows the board as a code repository's issue tracker: cards are issues, labels are labels, labels with a due date are milestones, comments are the conversation and attachments are the files. It also imports and syncs issues from GitHub, GitLab, Gitea and Forgejo.
help-board-view-version-control-how-it-w: Browse open and closed issues, filter by label or milestone, and open an issue to read and add to its conversation. A card counts as closed when it is archived or in a list such as Closed or Done. New issues become cards in the board's open list, and Close or Reopen moves the card between the open and closed lists. Everything is ordinary card data, so changes are kept in the board's history.
help-board-view-column-sets-what-it-is-d: Column sets let you arrange the same cards in extra ways, such as by priority, milestone or size, without moving any card out of its list. Each set has its own coloured columns.
help-board-view-column-sets-how-it-works: A board admin types a name in New column set and clicks Add, then adds columns with a name and colour. Choose a set at the top; every card is in one of its columns or in Not placed. Drag a card to another column to change its place in this set only; its list, swimlane, labels and members stay the same. Each card also shows small labels for its column in the other sets.
help-board-view-website-what-it-is-descr: The Website view shows the board as a website built from its own cards and attachments, for example a site imported from WordPress, Ghost, Blogger or a static site. A public board can open in this view, so visitors see the site at the board's address.
help-board-view-website-how-it-works-des: Cards in a list named Published are on the site, or every list's cards when there is no such list; archived cards never show. Cards in a swimlane named Pages form the menu, with subtasks as sub-pages, and the other cards are posts on the front page, newest first. A card's description is the page text and its attachments are its images and files. To use it as a public board's view, choose it in Board Settings / Board View.
help-board-view-shop-what-it-is-descript: The Shop view shows the products on the board's cards as a web shop, with pictures, prices, categories, a product page, a cart and a checkout. A card in a list on sale becomes a product when its price field has a number, and its labels become categories.
help-board-view-shop-how-it-works-descri: A board admin sets the shop up in Board Settings / Shop: the price, product code and stock fields, a private Orders list, the currency, VAT, payment methods, the lists on sale and the labels shown as categories, then ticks The shop is open. Shoppers filter by category, add products to the cart and check out. Each order becomes a new card in the Orders list, and the buyer gets a confirmation email.
help-sidebar-filter-what-it-is-descripti: The Filter shows only the cards that match what you choose, such as labels, members, assignees, dates, custom field values, card text or how long cards have been in a list. It changes no card and nobody's access, and a combination of filters can be saved under a name and used again.
help-sidebar-filter-how-it-works-descrip: Choose labels, people, dates or other conditions in the sidebar, and the board shows only the matching cards. Under Labels, OR matches any selected label and AND requires all of them; clicking a selected label again excludes it. Card text applies as you type. Closing the panel keeps the filter on until you clear it. Global Search, also here, finds cards across all your boards.
help-sidebar-search-what-it-is-descripti: Search finds the cards and lists of this board whose text contains what you type, and shows each card found on the board itself. On All Boards the same button narrows your list of boards by title.
help-sidebar-search-how-it-works-descrip: Type in the field and press Enter. The sidebar lists matching lists and cards, and the first card opens on the board with a counter under the field. Press Enter again for the next card or Shift+Enter for the previous one; the arrows do the same and wrap around. Click a card or list in the results to show it on the board, and click Search again to close the sidebar.
help-sidebar-multiselection-what-it-is-d: Multi-Selection lets you tick several cards and then do one thing to all of them at once: set a label or member, change the colour, move, copy or archive them. On All Boards it selects boards instead.
help-sidebar-multiselection-how-it-works: Turn on Multi-Selection in the board header, then tick the cards' checkboxes, or use Filter to selection in the Filter sidebar to select every card the filter shows. Choose an action in the sidebar, such as Set label for selection, Move selection or Move selection to Archive. Click Turn Multi-Selection off, the X beside the header button, when you are done. You need permission to change the board.
help-sidebar-custom-fields-what-it-is-de: Custom fields are the board's own extra fields for cards, such as a version, a budget, a customer, a checkbox or a choice from a list. A field is defined once for the board, and each card can hold its own value for it.
help-sidebar-custom-fields-how-it-works-: Click + to create a field, give it a name and a type (text, number, date, dropdown, multi-select dropdown, checkbox, currency or string template) and choose where it is shown: on the card, on the minicard, on new cards or on every card. The type cannot be changed later. Number and currency fields can show their sum at the top of each list. Card values are then filled in on the opened card.
help-sidebar-archives-what-it-is-descrip: The Archive holds the cards, lists and swimlanes that were moved to the Archive. Archiving hides something without losing it, so it can be restored later, while deleting removes it for good.
help-sidebar-archives-how-it-works-descr: Choose the Cards, Lists or Swimlanes tab and click Restore beside an item, or Restore all. A card may not be restorable while its list is archived or full under its WIP limit, and the Archive says so. Board admins also see Delete and Delete all, which cannot be undone. Archived boards are restored from the Archive page of All Boards instead.
help-sidebar-original-positions-what-it-: Original positions shows where each swimlane, list and card was put when it was made, and which of them have moved since. It is useful after a big rearrangement, or to see the title a card was created with.
help-sidebar-original-positions-how-it-w: Read the three groups, Swimlanes, Lists and Cards. Each item shows its current name, Moved when it is no longer where it was put, the place it was created in, its original title when that has changed, and when it was made. Click Refresh to read the board's history again. Items made before positions were recorded have no row.
help-sidebar-summary-what-it-is-descript: Summary is a standup report of what happened on the board, person by person, taken from the board's own records. It answers what each of us did in the last day or week, and what is overdue.
help-sidebar-summary-how-it-works-descri: Choose Last day or Last week. Each member who did something or has overdue cards gets groups for cards Done, Moved, Added and Commented, plus their Overdue cards, and each card opens from its link. Click Copy as text to copy the whole summary, ready to paste into a chat or an email.
help-sidebar-since-last-visit-what-it-is: Since your last visit lists what other people changed on this board since you last had it open: new cards, moves, comments, due date changes and members added. The menu entry shows the number of changes.
help-sidebar-since-last-visit-how-it-wor: Opening the board records your visit. Open this view to see the changes grouped by card, newest first, and click a row to open that card. Your own changes are not listed. An administrator can hide the feature in Admin Panel / Settings / Features.
help-board-visibility-what-it-is-descrip: Visibility decides who can see the board: only the people added to it (Private), every signed-in user of this WeKan (Signed-in users), or anybody with the link (Public). Editing stays with the board's members unless a board admin allows otherwise.
help-board-visibility-how-it-works-descr: A board admin clicks the visibility button in the board header and chooses Private, Signed-in users or Public; the current choice has a check mark and the button then shows the new setting. On a Signed-in users or Public board, when the administrator allows it, the admin can also tick Everyone signed in can edit. For other people the button only shows the setting.
help-board-watch-what-it-is-description: Watch sets how much you hear about this board: Watching notifies you of every change, Tracking only of changes to cards you created or are a member of, and Muted of nothing. The setting is your own; other members choose theirs.
help-board-watch-how-it-works-descriptio: Click the watch button in the board header and choose Watching, Tracking or Muted; your current level has a check mark and the button shows the new level. If the change is refused, a message says why and nothing changes. The button is hidden when an administrator has turned watching off.
help-board-sort-cards-what-it-is-descrip: Sort Cards changes the order cards are shown in inside each list: by due date, title, creation time, votes or the board's label order. It changes only what you see, and no card is moved.
help-board-sort-cards-how-it-works-descr: Click Sort Cards in the board header and choose an order; the cards in each list follow it and the button says Sort is on. Click the X beside it to remove the sort and return to the order the cards were dragged into. The choice is kept in your browser across reloads. For Label order, a board admin can change the label order with Move up and Move down when editing a label.
help-board-settings-what-it-is-descripti: Board Settings collects everything that is set for this one board: its rules, planning, colour and background, dates, views, swimlanes, lists and cards, export and import, notifications, webhooks and archive. Most entries are for board admins; your role and the site's settings decide which ones you see.
help-board-settings-how-it-works-descrip: Open the board's right sidebar with the hamburger menu and click Board Settings. Pick an entry and its own popup or page opens. The entries are grouped: rules first, then the board's look, then how it is drawn, then what goes in and out of it, and last the archive.
help-board-settings-color-what-it-is-des: Change color sets this board's own colour theme, which every member sees on this board. It is a way to tell boards apart at a glance. Only board admins can change it.
help-board-settings-color-how-it-works-d: Click a theme swatch; it is applied at once, with no Save button. For the flat and clear themes you can also pick your own colours with the colour wheels and check them in the preview. A colour you set for yourself in Member Settings still takes precedence over the board colour for you.
help-board-settings-announcement-what-it: A board announcement is a message a board admin writes for everyone on this board, shown in a bar above the board's lists. Use it for notes every member should see, such as a deadline or a change in how the board is used.
help-board-settings-announcement-how-it-: Write the text, up to 2000 characters of plain text, tick Show it to everyone on this board, and click Save. Members see the bar until they close it with its X, which hides it only for them. When the announcement is edited, it is shown again to everyone.
help-board-settings-background-what-it-i: A background image is a picture shown behind the board's lists, and also as the board's tile on the All Boards page. It can be an image address on the web or a picture uploaded and stored in WeKan.
help-board-settings-background-how-it-wo: Type an image address in Background Image URL and click Save, or use Remove Background Image to clear it. To store a picture, click Upload background image and choose a file; uploaded pictures are listed below, where clicking one makes it the board's background, and the icons download or delete it.
help-board-settings-date-what-it-is-desc: Date lets a board admin choose one date format for everyone on this board, instead of the format set for the whole site. The same popup has your own week number switch and, for board admins, calendar sync that puts the cards' due dates into a CalDAV calendar such as Nextcloud.
help-board-settings-date-how-it-works-de: Tick the board's Date Format, pick a format and click Save; untick it to follow the site setting again. A member's own enabled format in Member Settings still wins. Show week of year switches week numbers on or off for you at once. For calendar sync, enter the calendar address, user name and an app password, tick the sync box and Save.
help-board-settings-all-boards-what-it-i: All Boards Settings decides what this board's tile shows on the All Boards page, such as the card count of each list and the members' avatars. It also sets card aging, automatic archiving of untouched cards, and whether list widths are personal or shared.
help-board-settings-all-boards-how-it-wo: Tick or untick a row and it is saved at once. With card aging on, write three numbers of days after which cards fade in steps. For auto-archive, write how many days without activity a card may stay before it is archived, or leave it empty to turn that off. Templates are never archived.
help-board-settings-board-view-what-it-i: Board View chooses which views, such as Swimlanes, Lists, Table, Calendar, Gantt or the charts, are offered in this board's Board View menu, and which one the board opens in. It is set separately for when the board is public and when it is private.
help-board-settings-board-view-how-it-wo: The popup has one row per view and four checkboxes: the default view and the shown views for a public board, and the same two for a private board. Tick a view's Show box to offer it in the menu and its Default box to open the board in it.
help-board-settings-swimlane-what-it-is-: Swimlane holds the board-wide swimlane settings: whether swimlanes can be dragged, whether their height can be resized, whether all swimlanes share one row of list headers, and which Scrum fields a swimlane shows. WIP Limit Groups, shared work-in-progress limits over several lists, are also here.
help-board-settings-swimlane-how-it-work: Tick the boxes you want; the Draggable checkbox is in the table at the top. One shared list header row shows every swimlane with all of the board's lists under one header row that stays on top, without changing the lists. Click WIP Limit Groups at the bottom to add or edit shared limits.
help-board-settings-list-what-it-is-desc: List holds the board-wide list settings: whether lists can be dragged, whether their width can be resized, whether every list has the same width, and the Scrum field a list shows. It also turns on the Kanban flow policies: list policies, lists split into Doing and Done, a commitment point and a WIP limit per person.
help-board-settings-list-how-it-works-de: Tick the switches you need; the Draggable checkbox is in the table at the top. With resizing allowed, drag the handle between lists to change a width. A flow policy row appears only when that feature is turned on for the site, and once on, its details are set from each list's own menu.
help-board-settings-shop-what-it-is-desc: Shop turns the board's cards into a web shop shown in the Shop board view. A board admin chooses which custom fields are the price, product code and stock, which lists are on sale, which labels are categories, where orders are written and which payment methods are offered.
help-board-settings-shop-how-it-works-de: Set the rows and click Save; everything is saved together and checked again by the server. A card with a price in a list on sale becomes a product. Orders are written as cards to the Orders list, which must be on a private board, and the buyer can get a confirmation email. You can also make the Shop what visitors of the public board see.
help-board-settings-card-what-it-is-desc: Card decides what the minicards and the opened cards of this board show, and in what order, each independently. Use it when a board relies on a few fields, for example to put the description or the custom fields first, or to show the due date first on minicards.
help-board-settings-card-how-it-works-de: The popup has two panes, Show on Minicard and Show on Card. Tick or untick a section or a field to show or hide it, and drag rows to change their order. A few sections have their own menu with more settings, such as Subtasks and the card's dragging options.
help-board-settings-import-export-what-i: Export writes this board, or part of it, to a file: WeKan's own formats, spreadsheets, PDF, HTML, calendar files and the formats of many other tools. Import adds content from a WeKan export into this board. A board export is not a backup of the whole site.
help-board-settings-import-export-how-it: In Export, choose what to include first, then click a format and the file downloads. In Import, choose a WeKan export file in json or zip format and its content is added to this board. Import needs write access to the board, and either can be turned off by the site administrator.
help-board-settings-notifications-what-i: Notifications sets this board's defaults for email and in-app notifications, its due date reminders, email to card, and how notifications are delivered. A member's own explicit choice can still override the board default.
help-board-settings-notifications-how-it: For the in-app tray and email, pick Default to follow the site setting, or Yes or No to override it for this board. Under Due date reminders, write the days to remind on, separated by commas, where 0 is the due day and negative numbers are days after it, then click Save. The delivery sections below set what a notification carries, grouping and timing.
help-board-settings-webhooks-what-it-is-: Outgoing Webhooks send this board's activities to another service, such as a chat tool or your own integration, as they happen. Each webhook posts the activity's text together with the names and links of the board, list, swimlane, card and people involved.
help-board-settings-webhooks-how-it-work: Write a name, the address the receiving service gave you and, if it wants one, a token, choose the type and click Create. A saved webhook shows more options: which activities it sends, direct messages to card members for Mattermost, and how its messages are grouped and timed. Edit and Save it again, or use Disable This Webhook to stop it.
help-board-settings-scrum-meetings-what-: Two helpers for Scrum meetings, available to every member of the board. Daily standup is a timer that gives each member the same timebox, and Retrospective board makes a new board for a Start, Stop, Continue retrospective.
